A Broadway subway, for example, makes the Skytrain more useful to Surrey commuters.

In the short term, a Broadway subway may push SoF transit back in the queue. In the long run, however, it will only increase the need for transit SoF. The opposite is also true: transit South of the Fraser will increase demand North of it. It's a virtuous cycle. 

Transit investment is a virtuous circle that will lead to further transit investment.
